put.description:
Update the server settings and persist them to the configuration file.

Only the submitted options are modified. A JSON null removes an option
from the configuration file (restoring its default). Secret fields set

post.description:
Default user login method using forms (x-www-form-urlencoded).
Example: curl -X POST http://host:port/v3/access/users/login -H "Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded" -d "username=admin&password=admin"

Alternative authentication method using json.
Example: curl -X POST http://host:port/v3/access/users/authenticate -d '{"username": "admin", "password": "admin"}' -H "Content-Type: application/json"

Exchange a refresh token for a new access token.

Public endpoint — the refresh token itself proves identity. Respects the
user's token_version, so logout (which increments it) invalidates all
outstanding refresh tokens. Refresh tokens are stateless JWTs with a
longer expiry (default 30 days). Stolen tokens remain valid until their
`exp` or until logout — no replay protection without a server-side table.
Logout the current user by revoking all existing tokens.

direction.description: Direction filter: 'tx' = capture node sending only, 'rx' = capture node receiving only, 'both' or null = both directions.

capture_node_id.title: Capture Node Id
capture_node_id.description: Which endpoint's uBridge hosts this marker (the 'observer'). tx/rx in `direction` are interpreted from this node's perspective. Must be one of the link's two endpoints and a marker-capable type. Omitted = server auto-picks (first started marker-capable endpoint).

data_link_type.title: Data Link Type
data_link_type.description: pcap link-layer type the marker's BPF compiles against and its capture file is written with (a uBridge `linktype` token). Defaults to DLT_EN10MB (Ethernet), which is omitted from the uBridge command. Only meaningful for serial links: set it to the matching serial DLT from the port's data_link_types — DLT_C_HDLC / DLT_PPP_SERIAL / DLT_FRELAY / DLT_ATM_RFC1483 — so the BPF offsets and pcap decode match the encapsulation configured in IOS. Create-only (changing it would invalidate the pcap).

MarkerCreate.title: MarkerCreate
MarkerCreate.description:
Body for attaching a traffic-insight marker to a link.

``name`` is optional at the controller REST layer (auto-generated when
absent) but always set when the controller forwards to the compute.

name.title: Name
name.description: Unique definition name. Auto-generated when absent.

color.title: Color
color.description: User-chosen hex color for the marker in the Web UI, e.g. '#ff5722'

highlight_duration.title: Highlight Duration
highlight_duration.description: How long (milliseconds) the Web UI keeps this marker highlighted after a match. Omitted = use the UI default. Pure render hint — stored with the definition, never sent to uBridge.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: Direction filter: 'tx' = capture node sending only, 'rx' = capture node receiving only, 'both' or null = both directions.

data_link_type.title: Data Link Type
data_link_type.description: pcap link-layer type for inherited markers on serial links (uBridge `linktype`). Defaults to DLT_EN10MB (Ethernet): the definition then applies only to Ethernet links and serial links are skipped. Set a serial DLT — DLT_C_HDLC / DLT_PPP_SERIAL / DLT_FRELAY / DLT_ATM_RFC1483 — to also cover serial links with that encapsulation; Ethernet links stay EN10MB regardless. Changing it re-fans-out.

MarkerDefinitionCreate.title: MarkerDefinitionCreate
MarkerDefinitionCreate.description:
Body for creating / updating a project-level marker definition.

The definition is a template — when applied to a link the marker name is
prefixed with ``global-`` (e.g. ``arp`` → ``global-arp``) so it can never
collide with a per-link private marker.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: Direction filter; 'both' or an explicit null clears it to both. Omit to keep.

highlight_duration.title: Highlight Duration
highlight_duration.description: UI highlight duration in ms; null = UI default

MarkerUpdate.title: MarkerUpdate
MarkerUpdate.description:
Body for updating a marker — partial update, every field optional.

``bpf`` is optional here (it is required on create). ``capture_node_id`` and
``name`` are create-only / path-driven and intentionally absent; an explicit
``direction: null`` clears the direction back to both (omitting keeps it).
